entities.summary: Douglas Blair Lucek, better known as Doug Blair, is a heavy metal guitarist and member of W.A.S.P. Blair's early development as a musician took place in his home state of Connecticut. His focus on technical ability with the guitar quickly saw him gaining a reputation locally in the Tri-State area of New York, New Jersey and Connecticut.
